data.short_description: Newk's Eatery is exploring Phoenix-area franchise development that could bring up to 20 locations over the coming years. Founded in Oxford, Mississippi in 2004, the chain has over 100 locations nationwide.

Cono Gelato, a new gelato shop from former Canis chefs Jeff Kang and Tosh Agassiz, is opening at 932 College Street. Customers can expect 12 rotating in-house gelato flavors, brown butter waffle cones, gelato cakes, and waffle ice cream sandwiches.

Nop Shusang is part of a team planning a modern Thai-American concept called Saolea at 140 W 4th St, in the former Red Bamboo space that served vegan food for 24 years. A filing with Community Board 2 includes a sample menu, and ownership is seeking a beer and wine license.

data.location: 818 S Orlando Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
data.status: Preparing to launch; plans to invest hundreds of thousands to transform the interior
data.short_description: Tampa-based Fresh Kitchen is opening its seventh Central Florida location at 818 S Orlando Ave in Winter Park, in the former Chicken Guy space. The chain plans a new interior design concept and aims to open 50 restaurants over the next ten years.

data.location: 21803 I-10 (Suite 101, Dominion Crossing II), San Antonio, TX 78257
data.event_date: Construction completion expected July 17, 2026 (opening timeline not announced)
data.status: Renovation/alteration project; work expected to begin May 18, 2026 and complete by July 17, 2026
data.short_description: Sombra Restaurant is a new concept from chef Diego Gonzalez planned for Suite 101 at Dominion Crossing II, per Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation filings. The roughly 2,500 sq ft buildout carries an estimated $250,000 privately funded investment, with menu inspired by regional Mexican cuisine.

data.status: Expected to open in late summer or fall 2026
data.short_description: Deepwell is a New Orleans-inspired steakhouse from Joe and Katy Kindred, developed with corporate chef Craig Deihl as executive chef and co-owner. Plans include an in-house dry-aging program with Wagyu from North Carolina's W8 Ranch, in a historic downtown Mooresville building.

Cañonita is a Mexican restaurant from Tavistock Development's Restaurant Collection, with a $4.5 million investment, opening in a 9,321 sq ft space at Lake Nona West. It is the first restaurant announced for the development, which will also include Target, Nordstrom Rack, and other retailers.

data.location: 5600 N Harbor City Blvd #4, Melbourne, FL 32940
data.status: Plan review documents submitted; opening timeline not specified
data.short_description: Plan review documents submitted by Valdes Kitchen Inc. show Henry's Cuban Cafe #5 opening at 5600 N Harbor City Blvd, Unit 4 in Melbourne. The location joins a gas station at the address, and owner Henry Valdes was not immediately available for comment.

data.status: Preparing to expand; address and opening timeline not yet announced
data.short_description: HB Protein Smoothies is expanding into Gilbert through local franchisees Michael and Samantha Marquez, per QSR Magazine. The high-protein smoothie brand was founded by Daniel and Ethan Boone and offers more than 75 flavors.

data.status: New restaurant project in progress (plan review documents submitted)
data.short_description: Plan review documents submitted by ADC Hospitality Group LLC show a new restaurant project, Holy Grounds, in Suite 6 of the Deltona Boulevard retail center. The opening timeline and menu are not yet known, though the name suggests a possible coffee shop.

data.location: 5550 Douglas Blvd, Suite D-110, Granite Bay, CA 95746
data.status: Targeting an end-of-June opening, though no official date has been confirmed
data.short_description: Brew Bird Creative Cafe, a Sacramento concept blending specialty coffee with paint-your-own pottery, is expanding to Granite Bay. General manager Andrew Martin said the location is targeting an end-of-June opening, following the original Sacramento store that opened at the start of 2026.
